text: Xanadu pursues the continuous-variable route, where its own architectural blueprint identifies the generation of ___ states (a bosonic code, abbreviation of Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill) as the acknowledged hardest step toward fault tolerance.
explanation: Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) state generation is named in Xanadu's blueprint as the acknowledged hardest step toward continuous-variable fault tolerance, the CV analog of PsiQuantum's photon-loss problem.
